name: Viking Lander 1
about: Viking Lander 1 (1975-075C, LARCN), launched 1975 Aug 20. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.004 au and aphelion 1.663 au against GCAT's 1.001 and 1.669
